content.text: This AfternoonA 20 percent chance of rain. Mostly cloudy, with a high near 73. Windy, with a north northeast wind 13 to 23 mph, with gusts as high as 34 mph. TonightA 20 percent chance of rain before 8pm. Mostly cloudy, with a low around 33. Windy, with a north northeast wind 14 to 24 mph, with gusts as high as 36 mph. FridaySunny, with a high near 50. Breezy, with a north northwest wind 11 to 17 mph, with gusts as high as 25 mph. Friday NightClear, with a low around 26. North northwest wind 9 to 14 mph becoming light and variable after midnight. Winds could gust as high as 20 mph. SaturdayMostly sunny, with a high near 55. Breezy, with a south wind 7 to 12 mph increasing to 13 to 18 mph in the afternoon. Winds could gust as high as 26 mph.
